title: Magnetic spheres chain up in a field
description: 512 spheres carrying body-fixed magnetic dipoles (dipolar coupling λ = 6) drift and spin in a thermal bath at kT = 1. Without a field they link head to tail into wandering chains and rings. At t = 20τ a field ramps on over 2τ to α = 5 along z, and the chains swing into line with it.

title: Six pockets, one stroke
description: One cue strike starts a chain: each ball knocks the next one on and peels off into a pocket, and the last ball drops too. Six balls, six pockets. The layout was found by a search with the simulator in the loop; sliding, rolling and spin are simulated event by event, so every contact is exact. Every cut could be off by up to 0.9 degrees either way and still drop its ball.

title: Tunnelling on the pitch: fixed steps vs exact events
description: Six balls on one diagonal. The exact solver (solid, with elastic bounces) finds the real first contact between balls 2 and 3 at 0.06 s; the original fixed 1.234 s step (rings) jumps balls 2 and 3 straight through each other and reports balls 3 and 5 instead.

title: Magnetization climbs a field staircase
description: 256 weakly coupled magnetic spheres (λ = 1) in a field that steps through α = 0.5, 1, 2, 4 and 8. Each plateau's magnetization can be compared with the Langevin function L(α) for independent dipoles.

title: A repulsive gas at constant energy
description: 500 WCA spheres in a periodic box (ρ = 0.2) under velocity Verlet with no thermostat. The energy-drift panel is the integrator health gauge: |ΔE/E₀| stays at the 10⁻⁵ level for the whole run.
